message:
## Vulnerability Digest

No new vulnerabilities credibly matching the monitored product list were found in the last 24 hours. The review window was 2026-08-07 23:40 UTC through 2026-08-08 23:40 UTC (2026-08-08 05:10 IST through 2026-08-09 05:10 IST).

The sweep covered vendor advisories, public CVE/NVD records, CERT/CISA material, GitHub security advisories, and reputable security reporting. MongoDB was checked both directly and through adjacent terms including mongod, mongos, Atlas, Ops Manager, drivers, and connectors.

Candidate reports were excluded when they were older than the window, could not be tied confidently to a monitored product, duplicated an older disclosure, or lacked credible confirmation. A same-day claim involving WordPress was excluded because no consistent WordPress vendor release or authoritative CVE record could be verified; no item met the standard for a "Possible matches needing review" entry.

No immediate review is recommended based on newly reported issues in this monitoring window. Continue normal patching and inventory review for previously disclosed vulnerabilities.
